A little something
نورهان

This place was made only for you

Turn your sound on, and tap the heart when you are ready.

For my love

Nourhan

نورهان، نور عمري

Every word on this page is for you, and every photo is a day I would live again.

First, a letter

To the one who became my home

My love, habibti, I made this little corner of the internet for one reason: so that whenever you feel tired, or far away, or simply want to be reminded, you can come here and read how deeply you are loved. Nothing here is for anyone else. It was built slowly, thinking of you, one photo and one sentence at a time.

Your name means light, and I have never met a name that fits its owner so well. You walked into my life and the rooms inside me that were dim became warm. I did not know how much I was missing until you filled it, quietly, gently, the way morning arrives. Now I cannot imagine a day that does not have you in it, even if you are only in my thoughts.

I want you to know that I see you. I see how hard you try, how much you give, how you carry other people and forget to carry yourself. I want to be the person who carries you back. If the world is loud, I want to be the quiet place you rest. If the world is kind, I want to be right beside you, laughing at how lucky we are.

So read slowly. Take your time. Let each photo remind you of something we lived, and let each word tell you what my heart says every single day: I love you, and I choose you, again and again.

Our song, playing for you
أنت عمري

Enta Omri. You are my life. Umm Kulthum sang it for every heart that ever loved this deeply, and today it is how mine sounds when it says your name.

The first thing I fell for

I could get lost in your eyes and never ask for directions

There is a kind of calm in the way you look at me. It is soft, and it is brave, and it sees straight through every mask I try to wear. When you rest your head against my shoulder and the whole day goes quiet, I understand that this is what peace feels like.

If I could freeze one moment and live inside it, I think it would be this one: no words, no plans, only you leaning on me and the sure feeling that everything will be alright.

You, laughing

You make even the silly days feel like holidays

Look at us. Moustaches, glasses, a cap that does not belong to either of us, and I would not trade this afternoon for anything. You are beautiful when you are dressed up, and you are unbelievably beautiful when you are being ridiculous with me.

Thank you for being the person I can be completely myself with. Thank you for laughing at my jokes, even the bad ones, and for making me laugh when I forget how. With you, joy is not an occasion. It is just a normal Tuesday.

Small things that mean everything

Two hands, two little hearts on our wrists, one promise

This is my favourite photo, and it has no faces in it at all. Just your hand resting inside mine, the bracelets we wear, the rings, the pavement under our feet. It looks like nothing, and it is everything.

Whenever life gets heavy, I look at my wrist and remember that somewhere you are wearing the same little hearts. That is all I need to stand up straight again. I will hold this hand through every road, every crowded street, every quiet evening, and every year that comes after.

The day of the roses

A hundred roses, and still not enough words

I wanted to give you something as big as what I feel, and I learned quickly that flowers cannot do that. They will fade, and what I feel for you grows stronger each morning. The roses were only a way of saying, out loud and in public, that you are the person I want the whole world to know I love.

Look at how we lean into each other in these pictures. Nobody told us to stand like that. It just happens, the way a compass turns to north. Wherever I am in a room, my heart already knows which way you are.

What I promise you

Things I will keep doing for as long as I live

  • I will listen to you fully, even when you are telling me the same story for the third time, because I love how your eyes light up when you tell it.

  • I will be gentle with your heart. When we disagree, I will remember that we are on the same side, and that the problem is the problem, never you.

  • I will celebrate your wins louder than my own, and I will sit with you on the days when winning feels far away.

  • I will keep choosing you in the ordinary moments, when nobody is watching and nothing is special, because that is where love actually lives.

  • I will pray for you, dream with you, and build a home with you where there is always warm tea, soft laughter and a door that is always open.

  • I will never stop being the boy who walked up with a hundred roses, shaking a little, hoping you would smile.

Last, from my heart

If I could say it only once

Nourhan, you are my peace and my favourite adventure at the same time. You are the first thought in my head when I wake up and the last one before I sleep. You are in my prayers, in my plans, and in every picture I imagine when I think about the future.

Thank you for your patience with me, for your kindness, for the way you love so sincerely. Thank you for every message, every hug, every look across the table that says more than a speech. You have made me a better man, and I will spend my life trying to deserve you.

One day I want us to look back at this page, and at these photos, and laugh and cry a little, and say: look how far we came, and how it was always going to be us. Until then, I will keep holding your hand.

Yours, today and always

One more thing

Do you know how much I love you?

More than every rose, every star, and every word on this page.

I love you, Nourhan. Now, and tomorrow, and in every tomorrow after that.

Made with all my love, for Nourhan
